pages.text: Health 128, Armor 12, Attack 14, Knockback Resistance 0.8, Speed 0.35. Its melee randomly picks one of three swings that deal damage equal to its attack; if the target is not immune to Freeze, it also deals Freezing magic damage. At longer range it charges.$(br)Immune to powder snow.

$(l)Ice Rock Throw$(): at longer range it throws an Ice Rock for 3–30 Freezing magic damage and 2–20 armor-piercing damage, plus a 19-second Frozen effect.$(br)$(l)Yeti Deter$(): once against enemies within 18 blocks whose current health is lower than its own — Darkness III for 3s, Weakness III for 18s and Slowness III for 9s.
Hitting a target affected by Weakness grants it one layer of Rampant, with its tier and duration following the target's Weakness.
